# Test fixtures

`tanzil_simple_clean.json.gz` is the Quran text in plain spelling without
harakat ("simple clean"), one string per ayah, 6236 in all. The recitation
tests use it to stand in for what a speech recognizer writes.

It is the Tanzil Quran Text (Simple Clean) of the Tanzil Project
(https://tanzil.net), used unchanged under the Creative Commons Attribution
3.0 license. It was taken from the npm package `@ghoran/text`, which bundles
the same Tanzil text.
